verdict.rationale: After you approve a plan, ReelMimic runs a production job on its own: up to 6 agents build shots in parallel, separate agents review them, and the job pauses at limits and resumes where it stopped (docs-4, docs-5, docs-10, gh-6). The post-video CLI can also schedule a TikTok post for a set time (gh-9). This is autonomous per-job execution, not user-configurable automations. missing for 10: user-defined recurring or event-triggered automations, a documented always-on background scheduler, independent hands-on corroboration.
